==Quest information==
===Objectives===
*Talk to [[Glint]] in the Dragon's Lair.
* *BONUS* Defeat Glint.
* *BONUS* Complete the mission in [[Hard Mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 3,000 [[Experience]]
* 500 [[Gold]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 20 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
* Complete the first *BONUS* Objective for an additional 30 Zaishen Copper Coins.
* Complete the second *BONUS* Objective for an additional 50 Zaishen Copper Coins.

==Walkthrough==
As per [[the Dragon's Lair#Walkthrough|Dragon's Lair]] mission.
